Yes — we offer a Limited Lifetime Warranty on manufacturing defects. 😊

What that generally covers:

lids that won’t thread properly or leak when they’re supposed to be leakproof
insulation failure
plastic or silicone parts that are warped or not functioning
items that arrive damaged

What it doesn’t cover:

normal wear and tear
dents, scratches, chips, or fading
damage from drops, misuse, improper cleaning, or modifications
mold, odors, or taste issues caused by use or storage
